from rich.highlighter import ReprHighlighter
from rich.text import Text

def test_url_highlighting():
    highlighter = ReprHighlighter()
    url = "https://example.org/~user"
    text = Text(url)
    highlighter.highlight(text)
    
    # The URL should be highlighted as a single span
    # ReprHighlighter uses base_style = "repr."
    # The URL group is named 'url', but the style applied is base_style + group_name
    # Actually, RegexHighlighter applies base_style to the whole match if it's a simple regex,
    # but if it's a named group, it might be different.
    # Let's check the spans.
    
    print(f"Text: {url}")
    print(f"Spans: {text.spans}")
    
    # We expect one span covering the whole URL
    assert len(text.spans) == 1
    assert text.spans[0].start == 0
    assert text.spans[0].end == len(url)
    print("Test passed!")

if __name__ == "__main__":
